name: ManageEngine Patch Manager Plus
summary: Patch Manager Plus covers Windows, macOS, Linux and more than 1,100 third-party applications. It is priced by computer count, server count and technician, with cloud and on-premises editions. Professional cloud costs $345 a year for 50 computers, and a 30-day trial needs no credit card.

facts.text: The product page names Windows, macOS, Linux and 1100+ third-party applications.
ManageEngine describes deploying patches to non-compliant systems in controlled waves during maintenance windows.
Vulnerable Systems, Vulnerable Patches and System Health reports can be scheduled and emailed to stakeholders.
Cloud service is sold on subscription only, while on-premises licenses come as annual or perpetual.

plans.name: Professional cloud, 50 computers (annual)
plans.notes: Includes one technician. Monthly billing is $34.50. 100 computers cost $595 a year

plans.name: Enterprise cloud, 50 computers (annual)
plans.notes: Includes one technician. 100 computers cost $845 a year

plans.name: Professional cloud, 10 servers (annual)
plans.notes: Servers are priced separately from computers

hiddenCosts: Servers are licensed separately from computers.
Each technician beyond the first costs extra, starting at $195 a year for one on cloud.
The pricing page lists no free edition, so the 30-day trial is the only no-cost route.
